ai-data / Retrieval

Pinecone

Search infrastructure for relevant context.

POfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Store and retrieve searchable representations of approved information using Pinecone's supported database capabilities. MoreSpace can build a knowledge-search backend, product discovery layer, or retrieval service that feeds relevant context to an assistant. We design identifiers, metadata, refresh rules, and access filters before evaluating whether the returned results are useful for the actual customer or operator task.

Useful outputs

  • A searchable indexed collection
  • Ranked results with source references
  • Ingestion and query-quality reports

Where we can apply it

  • Approved documents → embeddings → indexed search → source-linked assistant.
  • Service catalog → searchable records → ranked discovery → enquiry journey.
  • Updated content → refresh job → index validation → current knowledge retrieval.
01

Use case 1

Retrieve relevant document passages for a knowledge assistant.

02

Use case 2

Build semantic product or service discovery on an approved catalog.

03

Use case 3

Maintain a searchable collection with metadata and refresh jobs.

Inputs we need

  • Approved content or catalog records
  • Embeddings and searchable metadata
  • Access and refresh requirements

Delivery sequence

  • Define record identifiers, metadata, and the collection's access boundaries.
  • Ingest content and configure the supported retrieval approach.
  • Test result relevance and maintain update and deletion routines.

Expert review points

  • Confirm retrieval filters enforce the intended customer or department scope.
  • Inspect recall and relevance on real search questions.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • LlamaIndex
  • LangChain
  • Embedding providers
  • Custom search applications

Signals we can make visible

  • Retrieval relevance
  • Query latency
  • Index freshness
  • Search acceptance rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
